title: 7.8 Could you repeat that, please?
unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
goal: Ask someone to repeat or to speak slowly (Could you repeat that, please?) and ask what a word means (What does hungry mean? It means you want to eat.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.8 Please Repeat: A1 repairs with I do not understand. Please repeat. Please speak slowly.; A1+ 7.8 asks politely and asks what a word means. The new grammar relationships are Could you + a verb + please? for a polite request (Could you repeat that, please? / Could you speak slowly, please?), building on A1+ 6.10's Could you tell me where …?, and What does + a word + mean? answered with It means … (What does hungry mean? It means you want to eat.). A1 7.8's photos of Ana puzzled at a ticket counter and on a street come back, and A1 7.2's hungry baby, thirsty man and tired grandfather and A1 7.4's cold woman show the words whose meaning is asked.
prerequisite: A1 7.8 I do not understand, please repeat, speak slowly, fast; A1 7.2 hungry, thirsty, tired; A1 7.4 cold; A1+ 1.8 don't; A1+ 6.10 Could you tell me …?.
speaking_outcome: Join Could you (KUD-juh) and let the voice go up at please?; stress MEAN in What does hungry mean?. Do not require native-like speed.
